word-pet.def: an animal that you keep at home for company

word-hamster.def: a small furry rodent with a short tail and cheek pouches, often kept at home

word-parrot.def: a colorful tropical bird that can copy human speech

word-guinea-pig.def: a small, round, furry rodent that people keep as a pet

word-turtle.def: a reptile with a hard shell that it can pull its head and legs into

word-goldfish.def: a small orange freshwater animal that people keep in bowls or ponds

word-aquarium.def: a glass tank where fish and water plants are kept

word-cage.def: a box made of wires or bars where birds or animals are kept

word-leash.def: a long strap or chain that you attach to a dog's neckband to control it

word-collar.def: a band worn around the neck of a dog or cat

word-pet-food.def: what dogs and cats eat, usually sold in bags or cans

word-vet.def: a doctor who treats sick or hurt animals

word-vaccination.def: an injection that protects a person or animal from a disease

word-microchip.def: a tiny device placed under an animal's skin that stores an ID number

word-flea.def: a tiny jumping insect that lives on animals and bites them

word-tick-insect.def: a small bug that attaches itself to skin and sucks blood

word-walk-the-dog.def: to take a pet out for exercise on a leash

word-bark.def: to make the loud, sharp sound that a dog makes

word-meow.def: to make the soft cry that a cat makes

word-tail.def: the part that sticks out from the back end of an animal

word-paw.def: the soft foot of an animal such as a cat, dog or bear

word-fur.def: the soft, thick hair that covers the bodies of many animals

word-feather.def: one of the light, soft parts that cover a bird's body

word-wing.def: the part of a bird, bat or insect that it uses to fly

word-beak.def: the hard, pointed part of a bird's mouth

word-horn.def: a hard, pointed growth on the head of an animal such as a cow or goat

word-deer.def: a wild animal with long legs; the males have branching antlers

word-squirrel.def: a small furry animal with a bushy tail that climbs trees and eats nuts

word-hedgehog.def: a small animal covered in sharp spines that curls into a ball

word-bat-animal.def: a small flying mammal that sleeps upside down and is active at night

word-camel.def: a large desert animal with one or two humps on its back

word-giraffe.def: a very tall African animal with a long neck and a spotted coat

word-zebra.def: a wild African animal like a horse, with black and white stripes

word-kangaroo.def: an Australian animal that hops and carries its baby in a pouch

word-panda.def: a large black and white bear from China that eats bamboo

word-crocodile.def: a large, dangerous reptile with a long mouth that lives in warm rivers

word-frog.def: a small jumping animal with smooth skin and long back legs that lives near water

word-lizard.def: a small reptile with four legs and a long tail

word-whale.def: a very large sea mammal that breathes air through a hole on its head

word-dolphin.def: an intelligent sea mammal with a long nose that often jumps out of the water

word-shark.def: a large sea animal with sharp teeth and a tall fin on its back

word-octopus.def: a sea animal with a soft round body and eight long arms

word-crab.def: a sea animal with a hard shell, ten legs and two claws

word-eagle.def: a large, strong bird that hunts other animals and has very good eyesight

word-owl.def: a bird with big eyes that hunts small animals at night

word-pigeon.def: a gray bird that is common in cities

word-crow.def: a large black bird with a loud, harsh call

word-swan.def: a large white water bird with a long curved neck

word-penguin.def: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly and lives in cold places

word-goose.def: a large water bird with a long neck, bigger than a duck

word-donkey.def: an animal like a small horse with long ears, used to carry loads

word-bull.def: an adult male of the cow family

word-rat.def: a rodent like a large mouse, with a long tail

word-ant.def: a tiny insect that lives in large groups and works together

word-mosquito.def: a small flying insect that bites people and drinks their blood

word-cockroach.def: a dark insect that lives in dirty places and comes out at night

word-worm.def: a long, thin, soft animal with no legs that lives in soil

word-snail.def: a small, soft animal with a spiral shell on its back that moves slowly

word-zoo.def: a place where wild animals are kept for people to visit and see
